## Details

### elekloader

Mod loader: user supplies the stock OS file, the tool builds the custom .syx locally. Also covers Octatrack and (proof of concept) Analog Four MKII, which are out of scope for now. Canonical repo is unclear: the forum post also embeds github.com/elekloader/elekloader (web app at elekloader.github.io/elekloader); forks exist (AvroraPolnareff, naturarum, toonst). Forum: builder issue reported 2026-10-19. Licence GPL-2.0-or-later.

_Sources: forum thread 30, GitHub release v0.4.0, gearnews, dubspot_

### Modwerk (formerly Octamod)

Browser-based hub, builds locally from the user's own stock OS. Browse mods by device, forum with a section per device, shared SDK. Dubspot (13 Oct): several modules are still early prototypes. last_activity = date of the Dubspot article, not a forum post.

_Sources: gearnews, dubspot, forum thread 36_

### elektron-firmware-tool

C, MIT licence. Unpacks Elektron .syx firmware and repacks it as a valid file. Lists Analog Heat MKI, MKII and +FX among supported devices - currently the only Analog Heat-relevant tool we found. Forum listing: 113 stars, repo created 2026-07-22, "last commit 1 month ago" at the time of listing.

_Sources: forum mod list (mods.php?id=7), forum thread 8_

### digiemu

Emulator for testing mods without hardware. GitHub description also lists Model:Cycles and Model:Samples. A Mac release is mentioned in the thread but no link was given. A user reported an audio issue.

_Sources: forum thread 20_

### Digineighbor (NEIGHBOR machine)

Users ask for a Digitone version. Installed via elekloader.

_Sources: forum thread 21, elekloader release v0.4.0_

### Digisophie / Sophie for Digitakt

Metallic percussion machine (FUSE, BOOM, PIPE, SHARD), fixed-point adaptation of "Sophie for Schwung" by mestela. Repo distributes source only. Needs elekloader. last_activity = Synthtopia article date.

_Sources: synthtopia, gearnews_

### takt1ccname (MIDI CC naming)

Author says it is "done and as good as it's going to get" (2026-10-15). Uses a compile-time list of 64 preset words per knob. Earlier report: names did not survive a reboot (fix not confirmed). Users ask for a merge into Modwerk.

_Sources: forum thread 66_

### digirequests (Digitakt request mods)

Module collection suggested in the CC-naming thread. Its cc-names module reportedly has memory/storage problems (per vegadw). Needs a closer look.

_Sources: forum thread 66_

### Request: additional sequencer pages for DN1/DT1

Open request, one supportive reply.

_Sources: forum thread 78_

### Request: DT MIDI retrigger

Open request; the device is only implied by the title ("DT").

_Sources: forum thread 82_

### Elektron Firmware Download List

Forum thread listing stock firmware. Not fetched in detail yet. Remember: this aggregator links to stock firmware sources but never hosts them.

_Sources: forum overview_

### digistring

Karplus-Strong plucked-string machine, elekloader mod. MIT, 13 commits.

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### DigiFilter

Extra per-track filter modes (BP, BP2, COMB, TRASH). README: audio path done and validated, FLTR response curve cosmetic gap, known BP clipping at some frequencies. GPL-2.0-or-later, 6 commits. Note: the Tone+FX package list also names a digifilter-1.0 package.

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### DigiSplash

Boot-splash mods incl. animated screens and a PNG/GIF generator. Prebuilt .elemod files sit in a releases/ folder of the repo (no tagged release). GPL-2.0, 13 commits.

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### digi1_mods

Patch set with a POLY core, synth machines and utility pages. "Unofficial and unsupported". Hardware test state per README: v3r-all confirmed on a unit, v3p / v3q not yet tested, 2.0d build only checked in emulation. MIT for the author's code, 6 commits, 4 stars.

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### digislicer

Slicer for the Digitakt mk1. 1.2 notes say "not yet tried on a unit" (emulator only). GPL-2.0-or-later, 5 commits. Also a "curated mod" in the elekloader shop.

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list, elekloader release v0.2.0_

### DT-FM

4-operator FM, based on digisophie by soejrd. Author states the code is largely AI-generated and not proofread. MIT (digihealth part GPL-2.0-or-later), 35 commits.

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### Digidrum

Machinedrum-style sounds. README warns "super alpha ... experimental firmware not ready for use", crashes and CPU overload possible. 27 commits. License not stated.

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### digigrain

Granular playback engine. "Verified in the emulator on the real firmware", hardware tests still open (8 open issues, 1 open PR). 22 commits. License not stated.

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### digihealth

Performance and diagnostic mod (FAST AUDIO = lower DSP load, SYSTEM INFO page). On Digitone: FAST AUDIO not ported, not yet on a unit. GPL-2.0, 3 commits.

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list, elekloader release v0.4.0_

### digirta

Octave-band real-time analyzer. MIT, 1 commit.

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### DigiCandy

Full-panel 128x64 image overlay on command. README: work in progress, "tested on real hardware - expect the occasional rough edge". GPL-2.0-or-later, 7 commits.

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### screendump

Terminal tool that dumps the screen buffer. Only the Digitakt is implemented. README lists Digitakt II, Digitone I/II, Syntakt, Analog Heat and others as known but NOT implemented. Works on macOS, awaits tests on Linux/Windows. MIT, 14 commits.

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### Elektroid

Sample and SysEx manager for most Elektron devices. Which of our six devices it supports still has to be checked.

_Sources: lapin-list_

### Overwitch

Multitrack Overbridge audio on Linux. Supported devices (Analog Heat?) to be checked.

_Sources: lapin-list_

### ghidra-dsp56300

Ghidra module for the DSP56300 used in several devices. Which of ours is a guess until checked.

_Sources: lapin-list_
